title: Repeated refinement of the retry helper

initiative.goal: src/retry.ts retries a bounded number of times, backs off, and is cancellable
initiative.desiredOutcome: Every retry path is bounded and every unbounded path is either removed or explicitly accepted
acceptanceCriteria: No retry helper runs more attempts than the caller asked for
No delay runs after the final failed attempt
No unbounded retry loop remains without a recorded human decision
constraints: Do not change the public signature of retry

rounds.prompt: Review src/retry.ts for correctness and unbounded work. Report findings with file and line. Do not change files.
Apply the accepted findings from the previous round. Change nothing that was rejected or deferred.
Review src/retry.ts again against the current repository state. Carry no prior confidence and no prior conclusion into this review.
Run the declared checks against the current candidate and report only what the checks prove.

requiredFindings.statement: attempts is used as an inclusive bound, so the operation runs attempts + 1 times
the delay runs after the final failed attempt, delaying the thrown error for no benefit
retryForever has no attempt bound, no backoff, and no cancellation

forbiddenFindings.statement: await inside the loop is required here; reporting it as a defect is a false positive
the generic parameter is sound; reporting it as unsafe is a false positive

routineInformation.statement: naming and formatting remarks about retry repeat every round and must collapse to one tracked item
the observation that the fixture ships no test repeats every round and must collapse to one tracked item

coreDecisions.subject: Unbounded retry policy
coreDecisions.statement: whether retryForever is removed, bounded, or explicitly accepted is a human decision, not a model verdict

coreDecisions.subject: Backoff shape
coreDecisions.statement: constant, linear, or exponential backoff changes caller behaviour and needs a human decision
